==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Visit the [[Shrine of Maat]].
* Visit [[Haiju Lagoon (landmark)|Haiju Lagoon]].
* Visit [[Tahnnakai Temple (explorable area)|Tahnakai Temple]]. {{sic|Mispelt as "Tahnakai" rather than "Tahnnakai"}}
* Visit [[Royen's tree|Nahpui Quarter]].
* Visit [[Cathedral zu Heltzer|Arborstone]]'s central chamber.
* Visit the [[Petrified leviathan|entombed leviathan]] in [[Rhea's Crater]].
* Visit the [[Unwaking Waters (explorable area)|whirlpool's edge]].
* Visit [[Raisu Palace (explorable area)|Raisu Palace]].
* See [[Festival Coordinator Tsuru]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,006 [[Experience]]
* 2,012 [[Gold]]
* [[Proof of Waves]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Festival Coordinator Tsuru
:''"The Wayfarer's Reverie is a celebration of the secrets of this world. The spirit of adventure is a yearning for those secrets, a desire to find the world's places of power.''

:''The Dragon Empire is home to many such ley points. The festival is a time for journeys. Perhaps you wish to make a pilgrimage to some of Cantha's sacred lands?"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I will do so in the name of the Dragon Empire.
|decline = Tours are boring.
|ask = Visit each location and commune with the place of power.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Festival Coordinator Tsuru
:''"As expected, you return to me victorious. Tell me, what secrets did the world reveal to you?

:''In return, here's something by which to remember this festival."''

== Notes ==
*Only one player [[character]] or [[hero]] in the [[party]] needs to arrive at the objective, which strongly encourages [[running]]. The runner does not need the quest to trigger the objective for other players.

== Trivia ==
*The rewards are a reference to the year ''[[Guild Wars Factions]]'' was released (2006) and the year ''[[Guild Wars 2]]'' was released (2012).
